test-case.name: examples-222-q1
test-case.description: Find the author of each book with a title containing a token with the same root as dog and the token cat.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-222-q1

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; for $b in $input-context/books/book where $b/title contains text ("dog" using stemming) ftand "cat" return $b/author

test-case.name: examples-222-q1b
test-case.description: Find the author of each book with a title containing a token with the same root as dog and the token cat.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-222-q1b

test-case.name: examples-222-q2
test-case.description: Find books that have a price of less than 50 and a title which contains a token with the same root as train.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test examples-222-q2

test-case.name: examples-222-q3
test-case.description: Finds books where either the title contains the token dog and the token cat and the content does not contain a token with the same root as train, or where the title fails to have one of the matching tokens but the content does.

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; $input-context/books//book[title contains text "dog" ftand "cat" ne para contains text ("train" using stemming)]

result.assert-xml: <book> <title>The Story of a Dog and a Cat</title> <author>Melton Mowbray</author> <date>1832</date> <publisher>Example Books</publisher> <price>100</price> </book>
